GeneratedBy.Name: Authors' epoching and artifact screening (MATLAB 2019a)
GeneratedBy.Description: Continuous icEEG (not released) segmented around the target sound; epochs with clinical or subclinical epileptic events removed by visual inspection; four-stage artifact rejection (Welch PSD peak > 200 µV/Hz above 30 Hz; MSE < 200 µV^2; MSE to the mean trace > 3000 µV^2, at most 20 % per electrode; samples > 5 SD); trials sorted into Perceived / Not Perceived / blank; grey-matter electrodes only (article sections 2.3-2.5). Released as 2-s epochs (Dryad README); removed channel-epochs are NaN. Some file names state further steps, e.g. 'sounds_restricted', 'CPonly', 'recalibrated', 'no_TTL_artifact_subtract_30Hz_movmean' (not documented further).
